workflow_runs.name: Issue Deduplicator
workflow_runs.display_title: Windows 10: Computer Use capture still times out on 26.1007.21434, blocking CapCut editing

head_commit.message:
Report exec runtime resets before accepting further requests (#52825)

## Why

Replacing a gRPC code-mode runtime loses stored values and running cells. Silently continuing after reconnection hides that loss, while prior external tool operations may already have completed.

## What changed

- Capture the runtime generation when `execute` and `wait` calls are created. If recovery replaces it, reject those calls with an explicit reset error, including concurrent calls and calls first polled after recovery.
- Explain the lost state and advise inspecting prior tool results before retrying. Allow a fresh `exec` call to continue on the replacement runtime.
- Keep `terminate` from reopening the runtime so cleanup cannot hide a reset from the next request.

## Testing

Extend gRPC recovery tests to cover reset errors after host restarts, missing sessions, and route loss, rejection of queued calls, and successful fresh execution with cleared stored state.
